text: dsh-intelligent-ui 是面向 DSH Web 的交互界面插件：模型可用结构化 DIL 内容生成可操作的回答。它向模型注册 render_ui 工具，并在对话工具调用期间及回复下方显示界面。用户可要求计算器、表单、仪表盘或图表，界面支持输入、滑块、选择、页签、按钮、表格和图表等控件；改动状态后会在浏览器侧重新计算。适合希望在 DSH Web 对话中直接操作数据或查看可视化结果的用户。安装命令为 dsh plugin --profile web add @left0ver/dsh-intelligent-ui，不需要额外配置。

dsh-intelligent-ui adds interactive DIL interfaces to DSH Web replies using render_ui. Users can request calculators, forms, dashboards, or charts with sliders, tabs, and tables; browser-side state changes update the view. Install with dsh plugin --profile web add @left0ver/dsh-intelligent-ui.
想让 DSH Web 根据我的问题生成一个可以现场操作的小工具。
能不能在对话里做一个计算器，让我改数字后马上看到结果？
我想把一组数据做成可以切换和调整的图表。
让 DSH 给我一个带输入框、选项和按钮的交互式表单。
有没有办法在回答里展示可排序的数据表和仪表盘？
I want a small interactive calculator in my DSH chat.
Can DSH show a chart that updates when I change its values?
Build an interface with tabs and form controls right in the conversation.
dsh-intelligent-ui 的功能「对话内生成界面」：模型通过 render_ui 工具提交 DIL 源码，界面在工具调用期间显示，并在本轮回复下方保留。
dsh-intelligent-ui 的功能「交互控件与状态重算」：生成的界面可包含滑块、输入、选择、复选框、页签和按钮；用户操作更新状态并触发重新渲染。
dsh-intelligent-ui 的功能「数据表与图表」：模型可在界面中呈现表格及折线、柱状、面积或饼图，供用户查看数据。

@left0ver/dsh-intelligent-ui README · dsh-intelligent-ui：**A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web plugin: the model answers with an interface you can operate, not just text.** [](package.json) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@left0ver/dsh-intelligent-ui) [](LICENSE) English · [简体中文](README.zh.md)

@left0ver/dsh-intelligent-ui README · Features：- **Appears as it is written**: each piece the model writes shows up at once.
- **Runs locally**: dragging a slider, editing an input or switching a tab recalculates on the spot, with no further request to the model.
- **Common controls**: sliders, inputs, selects, checkboxes, tabs, buttons, tables, progress bars, badges, callouts, collapsible sections, colour swatches, and line, bar, area and pie charts.
- **Sandboxed**: the program the model writes runs in a sandbox, with no network and no access to the page's data.

@left0ver/dsh-intelligent-ui README · 1. Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @left0ver/dsh-intelligent-ui
```

A freshly published version may be held back by pnpm's minimum release age. If so, add these two lines to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml` and install again:

```yaml
minimumReleaseAgeExclude:
  - '@left0ver/dsh-intelligent-ui'
```

@left0ver/dsh-intelligent-ui README · 3. Ask：Ask for a calculator, a tool, a chart, or to adjust the numbers yourself. Ordinary questions are still answered in text. For example:

```
I take home $6,000 a month and spend $1,800 on rent, $700 on food, $300 on transport and $500 on fun. I want to save $50,000 for a down payment. Build me an interactive view of where my money goes and how long it will take.
```

@left0ver/dsh-intelligent-ui README · Update and uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update @left0ver/dsh-intelligent-ui
dsh plugin --profile web remove @left0ver/dsh-intelligent-ui
```

@left0ver/dsh-intelligent-ui README · Known limitations：- The interface's state is not saved: reloading the page resets it.
- The model cannot see what you do in the interface, so a follow-up question does not know where you left the sliders.
